newsitem.title: CHINA: China oil tanker explodes, eight missing.
newsitem.headline: China oil tanker explodes, eight missing.

text.p: Eight people were missing after an oil tanker exploded and sank at an east China port on Wednesday, the official Xinhua news agency said.
The Daqing 243 tanker exploded while it was unloading oil at the Qixia anchorage in the inland port of Nanjing, engulfing two barges in flames. One of the barges sank, the news agency said.
The tanker belongs to the Guangzhou Ocean Shipping Group, Xinhua quoted the Ministry of Communications as saying.
The fire had been brought under control and efforts were being made to contain oil pollution, Xinhua said.
The cause of the explosion was under investigation. No further details were given.
